reviews.text: Professional, calm operation.

Really good vet! Prices are reasonable and the service is professional and friendly. Experience and knowledge are available, and animals are treated calmly and caringly. Overall, a very good and reliable place, I can warmly recommend it! 🐾🐈‍⬛
Andrzej Suchodolski took care of the dog's dental care. He is calm and treats animals with care.
Good professional doctor and reasonable prices.

My dog ​​and I were talked about like crap while I was waiting for the dog's pevisa pictures. They told other customers how strange customers we are and how strange my dog ​​is when he refused to get on the table. In the eye pictures, the older male doctor almost got nervous because my dog ​​wouldn't take them...

Use this place at your own risk, I won't be back.
And the last thing, the dog had to be lifted onto the table with the doctor himself.. I don't think it was very professional.
Nice and quick service. The place has music that helps to calm down pets.

We went on a pevisa day and it was a really terrible experience. Go away! First of all, there was no one to greet us when we walked in the door so we had to wait. Then the male doctor comes and apparently should have known that we would take the eye drops from the table and put them in ourselves? Where do I pay hundreds of euros if I have to do the procedures myself? Well, the eye exam went just fine. In the x-rays, while we were waiting for the medicine to take effect, the doctor forbade me from standing in front of my dog ​​and said who would pay if the dog bites??? Well, the pictures were taken and when I went into the room my dog ​​was lying on the mattress after which the male doctor started pulling the dog up with a leash even though the dog was REALLY tired. I had to intervene myself and forbid the doctor from doing that. Then we should have disappeared from the whole place within 5 minutes! You weren't allowed to pet the dog when you woke up because they say it doesn't help it wake up. A really terrible experience... the dog was treated really badly and in an assembly line manner. Never again
We have been there several times, really satisfied.

We took our two cats at different times and were very happy with the experience. The vet was calm, gentle, and professional. Both cats stayed relaxed during the visits, and everything was explained clearly. We really appreciate the care and highly recommend this clinic. 🐾 …
I took my cat to see a doctor for eye symptoms. Friendly and professional doctor, will be our primary place to go for treatment in the future. I highly recommend him.

My cat had an overgrown nail that had grown into the paw very badly, so I took her to the vet to get the nail trimmed and the wound cleaned.

My cat is a sweetheart at home but she's a former street cat who ended up in the animal shelter after some serious injuries. Because of how skittish she was when I first got her it's assumed that she might've been abused by people before. Now she's a total sweetheart but in unfamiliar places she will freak out and try to flee or bite. This is something I thought would be very important information for the vet to know and all the previous times I've been to other vets I've warned them about this and the vets have taken it into consideration.

The vet I saw in this place (an older non-finnish man) was not at all considerate of this. First of all he wouldn't let me close the door. If my cat would have made a run for it she could have ran right into the hallway and she could have gotten outside very easily if someone happened to use the front door. So right at the start I was already scared for my cats safety. Then when I warned the vet that my cat tends to bite when she's scared the vet got angry at me. He started to berate me about how my "negative energy" will make the cat attack him. Only after that did he take further safety measures and covered the cat in a blanket to avoid getting bit. He then quickly trimmed the nail and didn't clean the wound he didn't even look at the wound. Then before he let me pay and leave he continued to once again berate me for being worried the cat might escape and for warning him about the things my cat has done before. The rant was extremely rude and unnecessary. Extremely unprofessional place and it made me scared for my cats safety do not go here if you care about your pets. I have never gotten treated like this before at any other place.

Andrzej Suchodolski, an incredibly skilled veterinarian, was able to take an X-ray of a timid dog without anesthesia or even sedation. The ship dogs received good care, we have been here for 16 years with our dogs.
Veterinarian Andrzej does his job well and treats his patients gently. Recommended. 🐱 …
Always good service, been visiting regularly for over ten years.

The best, 10 POINTS! We have been going with three dogs for twenty years. The most animal- and customer-friendly service we have ever seen, examinations and treatments done so professionally and painlessly that the dogs have never been nervous about going. They don't take unnecessary tests, but they treat them well. Prices are reasonable.

I can't recommend the place to anyone, especially for dogs that are sensitive to stress. The man who did the Pevisa test was really rude to our dog, and didn't listen to the dog's needs or the owner. The vaccination was done by another man and he was a really nice guy. But unfortunately the man who did the Pevisa test ruined the whole place for us...

It's been a while since my cat's doctor visit, but I still have to write a review because I'll never go to that place again.

First of all, the appointment I booked wasn't recorded anywhere and when I went there, they were performing surgery. Well, I got my cat into treatment after a short wait. The first visit was fine, the female doctor was nice, I gave the cat cortisone for asthma symptoms. After a day, the cat started showing symptoms and the next morning we went to the vet again to have the symptoms checked. I was sure it was the cortisone, but the doctors didn't believe it. It was Friday and I wanted the cat to have blood tests taken, but the doctor suggested that we come back on Monday to have the samples taken again, as the results would only be available for examination then. So I should have brought the cat to the doctor for the third time in less than a week?! And it was completely pointless because the blood tests could have been taken on Friday as well and I said that they would be taken now. The doctor then said to just continue the medication despite the cat's symptoms. He said that I could wait over the weekend with it, but if the symptoms were from the medication, there was no need to go to the emergency room. When the results came in, the blood fat content was really high and they couldn't find a reason. I investigated the matter myself and found that cortisone could cause this. Luckily, I didn't continue the medication and luckily the symptoms eased.

When the results came in, the lab had recommended a complete blood count, i.e. new blood tests. At this point, I was angry, because why weren't they taken the first time, especially when they didn't know what was wrong with the cat???!! Of course I thought they would take all the tests, but apparently not. And I haven't realized that they also make sure that they will take all the necessary tests now. It felt like the whole thing was just a money grab and they don't really care about the animal and its well-being. They just want us to come again (for more money) and do the tests half-heartedly.

I don't recommend this place. It's worth going to the vet on Sopulitie, the service there has always been really good❤️
